note: Consensus market assumptions by horizon. Each band runs from the plan's first year to the year given (inclusive); the last band runs on.

sources.inflation: Cleveland Fed expected inflation, November 2026 (FRED EXPINF1YR to EXPINF30YR): 1y 3.04%, 2y 2.87%, 3y 2.79%, 5y 2.72%, 10y 2.67%, 20y 2.65%, 30y 2.66%; each band is the forward rate between horizons.
sources.stocks: US large cap, nominal: median of 14 firms' 10-year forecasts, 6.5% (PortfolioLab, November 2026: J.P. Morgan 2027 LTCMA 7.5%, BlackRock 9.0%, Vanguard 4.8% to 6.8%, and others); 20-year: Horizon Actuarial survey average, 7.0%.
sources.bonds: US aggregate bonds: median of 14 firms' 10-year forecasts, 4.8%; 20-year: Horizon Actuarial survey average, 5.1%.
sources.cash: Median of 9 firms' cash forecasts, 3.5% (PortfolioLab, November 2026).
sources.volatility: Standard deviation of yearly returns in the app's history (Damodaran): stocks 16.0% over 1976 to 2025 (19.4% since 1928), 10-year Treasuries 7.9% since 1928.
